dataset.name: Tagged registrant identity in an explicit EDGAR filing
dataset.description: Bounded extraction of tagged DEI registrant name and CIK with source-byte locators and referenced contexts. Other filing contents remain opaque bytes. This is neither a full XBRL processor nor FEC identity approval.

acquisition.pagination: None. Caller supplies CIK, accession and primary-document basename. No latest-filing or amendment selection is implemented.

partitions.name: capture
partitions.source: Explicit filing reference and exact observed document bytes
partitions.purpose: Source observation, not a FEC cycle or identity-validity window.

acquisition.retry_policy: One fixed-origin HTTPS GET per invocation; 30-second timeout, 16 MiB body and 128 KiB response-header caps. Declared operator contact from SEC_USER_AGENT or explicit flag. No auth, inherited proxy, redirects, retry or alternative host. Preserve failed observations; an oversized body is a labeled unusable prefix. New private directory and final manifest required.

physical_schema.encoding: Strict UTF-8 XML or ASCII/US-ASCII declarations with ASCII-only bytes. Not tolerant HTML. One XHTML root, no DTD/directives, duplicate attributes or contexts, maximum depth 128.
physical_schema.null_policy: Extract only inline-XBRL 2013 nonNumeric facts with official DEI year namespaces and EntityRegistrantName or EntityCentralIndexKey concepts. Retain missing or conflicting values as ineligible facts; never substitute prose or null defaults.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Versioned token profile in internal/source/sec/filing.go, not a JSON schema for XML. Maximum 1024 selected facts, 8192 decoded text bytes per selected fact and 50000 contexts. QName values resolve against their in-scope namespaces. Preserve raw document hashes and exact fact/context byte spans. Uninterpreted financial tags are opaque, not accepted typed facts.

identity.publisher_record_key: Explicit issuer CIK, accession and document basename. The accession prefix may identify a filing agent rather than the issuer.
identity.occurrence_locator: Capture and body digests plus zero-based start-inclusive/end-exclusive byte offsets. Each selected fact also retains its own span digest, ordinal, original id and contextRef.
identity.record_version: Exact captured body SHA-256; observation does not select a current or effective filing.
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve repeated selected fact occurrences. Duplicate fact IDs are ineligible; duplicate context IDs block parsing. Competing names or CIKs cannot be silently collapsed into an approved identity.

children.locator: Source context ID and exact byte span, bound by full document SHA-256

time_fields.meaning: XBRL reporting context, not an employment, connected-organization or legal-name validity interval.
Retrieval observation time, not filing or amendment precedence.

rules: Keep decoded tagged text separate from original source bytes. Do not infer identity from surrounding prose or financial text.

Only untransformed selected facts with id/name/contextRef attributes are eligible. Extra selected-fact attributes, continuation, nested non-XHTML content, missing contexts, dimensions and identifier conflicts remain explicit blockers.
Usable contexts have one SEC-scheme CIK entity identifier and one valid ordered date period or instant. Preserve original CIK text; derive zero padding only for identifier comparison.
A usable parsed source can contain no eligible identity facts. Comparison must then report incomplete evidence, not a verified negative identity.
The comparison policy uses format-only Normalize against original FEC query text. It does not expand the directory name vocabulary or ignore parent/bank/holding distinctions.

The directory and filing are separate SEC resources, not independent proof binding FEC text to a CIK. Preserve original directory alternatives and all FEC source references. Identity, employment, ownership and financial approval flags remain false.

revisions.publisher_model: Retain each exact filing-document observation separately; do not overwrite prior captures.
revisions.effective_projection: No submissions adapter, latest or amended filing selector, recurring refresh, historical identity interpolation or graph publication.

checks.rule: Require exact manifest/body pins, constructed SEC URL, confined regular files and bounded lengths.
Malformed or unsupported XML is an explicit unusable source; only the selected DEI identity profile is interpreted.
Preserve unsupported transformations, missing contexts, dimensions, duplicate IDs and conflicting identifiers as ineligible evidence.
A name match is supporting evidence, not approval. Preserve ambiguous and uninspected directory candidates and unknown transaction-time identity.

scenarios: Exact public annual report matches normal Go capture body
Two tagged registrant identity occurrences with source locators and annual contexts
Private operator request-contact metadata is not committed

use.retention: Preserve exact public filing bytes and private contact-bearing captures/results separately. Synthetic XML and mutation tests live in internal/source/sec/testdata and are not real registrant assertions. Live capture and replay are a narrow parser gate, not population-wide source or identity acceptance.
use.disclaimer: Filed name/CIK observations are not FEC identity, employment, ownership or money-flow approval.
